every write except SAVE echoes in about 4-12 ms; SAVE answers with a short 00 EE frame instead of an AA echo; reply frames carry stale bytes after EE (research/protocol/PROTOCOL.md:265-267)

the slot query 0x16 returns stale data on a USER slot after any band or preamp traffic; right only straight after a select or a SAVE (research/protocol/PROTOCOL.md:270-273); this is the snowskyExchange path (core/native/FiioCatalog.kt:83-85)
FiiO Control in the background holds the HID interface; Contour cannot connect while it runs (dac-lab:devices/snowsky-melody.md)
FiiO Control config lists a coaxial switch for the Melody that is a template copy (no coaxial jack); left out (scope-fiio.md:168,236-239)
gain -12..12 is the code's and FiiO Control's range, the FiiO web app lists -24..12 (kept until a capture shows the DAC keeps -13 dB); Q 0.1-10 is the code's range, the vendor apps list 0.25-8
preamp register offset is 0 until measured: the KA15 plays USER presets 12 dB down, the Melody was not swept

reset.src: FiiO Control shows Restore default settings (command 0x21; payload 01 00 comes from the FiiO web app generic builder, not from a capture on the Melody); Contour ships FACTORY RESET on the Melody with a saved copy first (FiioReset.OFFERED and VERIFIED; run:2026-10-22-snowsky-melody-01-phone) (scope-fiio.md:169,176-178,244)

hwVolume.src: vendor HID volume 0x02 write verified on hardware (scope-fiio.md:157,181); UAC Feature Unit 0x0A exists but no vendor software uses it

evidenceCaveats: No capture file: the USB product ID (2972:0126) was measured on the Melody; fixture comment claims -24/+12, authoritative resolved constraints remain -12/+12

rangesAccepted.note: Ten bands (a shorter count reads back as 10), USER1-3, PK, LS, HS and the four pass types written and read back on the PC and on phones; preamp -12, 0 and +12 dB hold. The DAC keeps whole dB only (-11.9 dB is written as -119 and reads back -11.0), so the plan rounds the preamp down to a whole dB.

acoustic.note: PK within 0.083 dB with the register as Q (6 of 6); shelves within 0.075 dB with shelf Q = register / sqrt2 (12 of 12 cases fit). LP, HP, BP and AP and the preamp level were not measured.

persistence.note: Only a slot switch and back was checked (USER1 restored bit for bit); a power cycle after a save was not tested.

settings.note: Volume, volume steps, balance, filter, gain, output, DRE, mic, light and buttons written, read back and restored on a Pixel (the filter echo comes after about 340 ms); the USB audio row is never written. The coaxial switch in FiiO Control is a template copy (no coaxial jack) and is left out.

tested.beyondVendor: FiiO Control and the FiiO web app list all seven filter types for the Melody; the web app was never captured on a Melody. Contour offers the four pass types since 2026-10-25 (written and read back from a phone). Contour offers FACTORY RESET with a saved copy first (proven on the PC and a phone 2026-10-22: one 0x21 frame, replug, saved copy written back).
